title: Cardinal Billing Account Assisted Payments and Member Tenure: Loyalty Rate on the Representative Fee
content:
**Clause.** A loyalty rate multiplies the representative payment fee on a Cardinal Billing Account assisted payment: **0.50** when the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's original inception date is at least 60 whole months before the payment date and no payment on the account was returned in the last 12 whole months; **0.80** when exactly one of those two holds; **1.00** when neither holds.

Tenure runs in whole months from the original inception date on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy to the payment date. A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the payment date, counted on calendar months; a returned payment is a returned-payment entry on the account's billing history.

## Truth table

| Inception at least 60 whole months before the payment date | No returned payment in the last 12 whole months | Loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.50 |
| Yes | No | 0.80 |
| No | Yes | 0.80 |
| No | No | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, no returned payment in the window)

| Whole months from inception to the payment date | Loyalty rate |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.50 |
| 59 | 0.80 |
